# clickup_comment_reply (Resource)

Replies to an existing ClickUp comment. The reply is itself a comment, updatable and deletable via the comment endpoint.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comment_text` (String)
- `parent_comment_id` (String)

### Optional

- `assignee` (Number)
- `group_assignee` (Number)
- `resolved` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `comment_id` (String)
